reasons.phone: Named in one look with its key part: the flyover's deck and a postered pier over a danfo at the painted kerb, the conductor calling with both arms up at its back, a hawker with a tray, and the player's diamond clear against the grey pier, no longer on the roof load. The near frame is no longer bare: a man on a parked okada, the woman in front, a drain grate. Was 4.
reasons.silhouette: The plan: both carriageways, the bay with two danfos, the keke, okadas, the grill's umbrella and a palm. The south pavement is still mostly empty (an okada and two grates on it). As the earlier sheet.
reasons.proportion: Danfos, the okada, the conductor and people agree; the near okada is large only because it is near.
reasons.palette: Palette only. The shade band under the deck helps the phone shot, but in the low desktop view the far shops still dissolve into the fog's wash and the ground is one grey-beige. As the earlier sheet.
reasons.wear: The conductor, roof loads, drain grates, hawkers' trays, the stall, litter. The smoke is now the smooth blended puff with its light side turning with it (the high mode's desktop shot, walked to the grill's smoke), the soft shape assets:flat-and-smooth-shading asks for; its outline is still a polygon. The bridge's underside is still unstained. As the earlier sheet.
reasons.variety: Same family as the examples; the flyover, the danfos and the conductor are plainly this place. As the earlier sheet.
reasons.budget: First-load row 60 and 60,000. Preview on the Pixel 7: 25 draw calls and 22,662 triangles (the earlier sheet 28 and 27,914); place check 25 and 25,418 moving. 42% at most.

reasons.phone: As low, with a helmeted rider on the okada, more of the queue, and shadows under people and the okada. Was 4.
reasons.silhouette: As low. As the earlier sheet.
reasons.proportion: As low; shadows sit people and vehicles on the ground.
reasons.palette: Fuller colour; on the desktop the shop rows show their boards between the danfos and the stall's umbrella reads. The underside's browns still run together into flat bands. As the earlier sheet.
reasons.wear: As low; on the desktop the crossers carry the scene across the bay and the road. As the earlier sheet.
reasons.variety: As low. As the earlier sheet.
reasons.budget: Exterior row 80 and 80,000 for the hub's high mode. Preview on the Pixel 7 with the shadow pass: 52 and 51,840 (65% and 65%); place check 50 and 52,324 moving. At or under 80%. The earlier sheet's 4 was against the first-load row (97% and 99.7%); against that row this sheet is 87% and 86%, so not lower either way. The desktop's first view, 61 to 65 draw calls and up to about 62,300 triangles, is over the first-load row and 81% of the exterior row; city:places-meet-party-room-bar gates the phone profile.

readsAsOjuelegba: Yes, on the phone in one look: the flyover over a danfo stop with its conductor calling is the picture of Ojuelegba.
crowd: Reads as a junction now, not only a queue: the conductor with both arms up, crossers on the pavement, across the bay and across Ojuelegba Road (caught mid stride on the desktop), a hawker at the road edge, a man on a parked okada. The band says Busy in the low mode (8 of 12) and Packed in the high (12 of 12): the word now follows the picture. No crop top and denim shorts in the sample. The resident card works (Chinedu, passing through. Lives in the city.) and no tag shows but the player's diamond.

reasons.phone: Named in one look as a danfo stop under a flyover: the deck's underside and a hammerhead pier fill the top third, a danfo with its roof load stands at the black and white kerb, people wait at its door. Not 5: the lower 40% of the frame is empty pavement, the player still stands in the middle, and her gold diamond lands on the danfo's roof load so it reads as part of the load. Was 2.
reasons.silhouette: The plan now says junction under a bridge: the two carriageways overhead, the loading bay with two danfos, a keke and an okada at the kerb, the cross road under the bridge. Not 5: the bottom 60% of the plan is an empty paved square with one palm. Was 2.
reasons.proportion: Danfo, kerb, people and the stall agree; the deck's underside sits about 5 m up, which clears the danfo. The dark slabs set in the pavement have no size that names them.
reasons.palette: Palette only and the danfo yellow carries the frame, but in the low mode the far shops dissolve into the fog's wash (only ghost outlines in the desktop view) and the ground is one dull grey-beige across 40% of the phone frame. As before.
reasons.wear: The right clutter where it would be: the roof load, the kerb paint, litter scraps, the stall's tomatoes under two umbrellas, a hawker's tray, the drain pipe down the pier. Not 5: the bridge's underside has no stains, the pavement no drain or water. The grill smoke is a column of faceted grey balls, the hard-edged look assets:flat-and-smooth-shading rules out for soft shapes. Was 3.
reasons.variety: Same family as the accepted examples; the flyover, the danfos and the keke are plainly new; the shop rows beyond are the example row. Was 3.
reasons.budget: Reported on the Pixel 7 profile: 28 draw calls and 27,914 triangles against the first-load row's 60 and 60,000, under 80% of each.

reasons.phone: As low, and the shop beyond the stop now shows with its board and goods. The same faults: diamond on the roof load, empty lower frame. Was 2.
reasons.proportion: As low; shadows sit people and vehicles on the ground.
reasons.palette: Fuller colour, the far haze keeps the shop rows and the plaza apart from the sky, the umbrellas and boards read. The underside's three browns still run together into flat bands.
reasons.wear: As low, with more of the stall's knot and the hawker in view on the desktop. The smoke is still faceted. Was 3.
reasons.budget: Reported on the Pixel 7 profile with the shadow pass: 58 draw calls and 59,790 triangles against the first-load row's 60 and 60,000, so 97% and 99.7%: inside, over 80%. Was 0 at 65 draw calls. The desktop's first view is 65 draw calls and 62,810 triangles, over the same row; city:places-meet-party-room-bar gates the phone profile only, so it does not count here, but 210 triangles of room on the phone is nothing.

earlierRound.readsAsOjuelegba: Yes on the desktop, and yes on the phone on a second glance at most: the flyover over a danfo stop with its queue is the picture of Ojuelegba a Lagosian carries. The shell read as any shop street; this reads as this junction.
earlierRound.crowd: Reads as a queue at a bus stop, not yet as a junction. On the desktop: a line of people along the kerb at the danfo's door, a man in a cream kaftan by the stall, a hawker with a tray on her head at the road edge, a few round the stall. On the phone only five residents show, evenly spaced along the kerb, all standing still and facing the road; nobody crosses, nobody is on the road, nothing shows which one is the conductor. The band says Packed in the low mode (9 people) and Busy in the high mode (13 people), the busier picture getting the quieter word. Dress: about three of nine in traditional cloth in the low desktop view; in the high phone shot the woman in the crop top and denim shorts stands at the stop again, the same fault the shell review named. The resident card works (Chinedu, passing through. Lives in the city.) and no tag shows but the player's diamond.
